thread:
Priya: Heads-up: starting a staged rollout of 'runnable snippets' in docs. Goal: keep code samples executable and up-to-date by running them in CI and surfacing failures in docs PRs. This will require small SDK shims and a docs linter check.

Arun: Quick summary for eng: we'll add a docs-snippet-runner CLI that spins up ephemeral containers, installs the package from the PR, runs snippet blocks marked with `run:true`, and reports pass/fail. Non-run blocks are unchanged.

Mei: SDK changes: add a `dev/snippet-runner` entrypoint and a tiny test-helper `SnippetTestHarness` that exposes env-driven credentials (SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN) and local mock endpoints for deterministic outputs. No runtime behavior changes for customers.

Hana: Security note: all snippet runs will run in sandboxed, network-restricted containers. By default outbound network is disabled; tests that need network must opt in with a per-PR approval step. We'll also scan snippets for common secret patterns and error out.

Leo: Support implications: customers might open bugs saying docs examples changed behavior. We'll add a short "why examples might fail" KB and a rollback path for urgent docs fixes. Also we'll provide a support contact for CI false positives.

Priya: Example front-matter for docs to opt in:
```yaml
---
run: true
runtime: python:3.11
setup:
  - pip install -e /workspace/checkout
  - export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN
---
```
Snippet runner will execute the fenced code block after running `setup`.

Arun: CLI example (local):
```bash
# from docs repo root
docs-runner run --pr 1234 --checkout . --concurrency 4
```
The runner posts results back to the PR as annotations and to a short dashboard.

Mei: PRs (WIP): py-sdk runner bits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/5321, js-sdk snippet helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/4207. Please review but do not merge until QA + security review.

Hana: Approval flow: any docs PR that enables outbound network must be manually approved by Security via the docs runner UI. We'll add a short webhook that blocks CI until approval.

Arun: Rollout timeline:
- Week 0: announce + draft docs changes (this thread).
- Week 1: land snippet-runner alpha in docs CI (opt-in via env).
- Week 2-5: run in opt-in mode, collect failures, fix flaky snippets.
- Week 6: enable required check on docs PRs (soft enforcement for 2 weeks).
- Week 8+: required check enforced for new docs PRs.

Priya: Docs teams: please mark critical samples as `run: true` iteratively; don't flip everything at once. We'll prioritize quickstarts, SDK quick samples, and onboarding pages.

Leo: Support will watch for any customer-facing regressions and keep a short rotation during Weeks 6-9.

Mei: Implementation detail: snippet harness will replay deterministic mock responses for network calls when `MOCK_REMOTE=true` to keep runs fast and stable. We'll publish the mock fixtures.

Hana: We'll add an automated SBOM check for any new languages or packages added to the snippet runner images. No new base images without Security signoff.

Priya: Action items: Arun opens docs-runner repo checklist, Mei finalizes SDK helper PRs, Hana drafts the approval webhook, Leo readies KB. I'll post a rollout checklist to #docs later today.

ci-bot: CI created: docs-runner alpha job (opt-in) + PR annotator integration. See https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/4821 for logs.
